summary: Forest Service lookout on Morton Peak: built 1925, replaced 1950, used until 1998, restored from 2012. Reached by a 9.4 km trail or a rough 4x4 road.

facts.design: Fire watch hut on the summit

staffing.status: Used by the Forest Service until 1998

access.note: Reached by a 9.4 km trail with flagged, less obvious route near the summit, or by a rough 4x4 road from Kingfisher that may be closed by snow until August. No source says whether the building is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: 9.4 km trail; the maintained trail ends at a 4x4 post where it enters Kingfisher Creek Provincial Park.

events.note: BC Forest Service first constructed the Mara lookout.
A new structure replaced the 1925 lookout; it was used until 1998.
Used by the Forest Service until 1998.
Province announced initial restoration and upgrading, due to finish mid-October 2012. A local account calls the 2012 funding a complete restoration.
BC government paid for restoration and took over management of the site through Recreation Sites and Trails BC.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2012 province notice calls the work initial restoration, due to finish in mid-October. A local account calls the 2012 government funding a complete restoration. The story reports both descriptions and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Dangerous Roads (source 4) says the mountain is in the Regional District of North Okanagan; the Shuswap sources read name no regional district, and the brief has no local_unit, so the story names only British Columbia. The 1950 date is given as 'current structure' by the newspaper and 'new structure' by the local account; both agree. The BC gov release is undated in the fetched text; the 2012 date comes from the Vernon Morning Star date line. The brief's kind 'two_story' is not supported by any source read, so the story does not describe the building's form. Sitesandtrailsbc REC160153 returned no text. Photos were not added. This record used seven page reads, one over the budget, because two sitesandtrailsbc fetches returned no text.
